headword: {日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}
gloss: day-trip hot spring, hot spring for day use

definitions.gloss: day-trip hot spring, hot spring bath for day use
definitions.explanation: A hot spring facility that can be enjoyed without an overnight stay, allowing visitors to bathe and return home the same day.

examples.japanese: {日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Let's go to a day-trip hot spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}できる→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: This inn also offers day-use hot spring bathing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: On my day off, I went to a nearby day-trip hot spring with my family to relieve our fatigue.

notes:
A popular leisure activity in Japan, referring to visiting a hot spring (⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧) facility for bathing without staying overnight. Many ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ and dedicated facilities offer ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧ plans at a lower cost than full stays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to a day-trip hot spring
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: day-use hot spring facility
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧⟦{入浴|にゅうよく}→入浴：11642_nyuuyoku⟧: day-use bathing

USAGE:
Often shortened to ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧⟦{入浴|にゅうよく}→入浴：11642_nyuuyoku⟧ (day bathing) or ⟦{立|た}ち{寄|よ}り→立ち寄る：04638_tachiyoru⟧⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (drop-in bath). Signs at hot spring resorts commonly advertise ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧OK or ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧{可|か} to indicate day use is available.
